beats.headline: One of the dancers, under contract
beats.text: He arrives by teleport trap outside the Madness castle with Katia, Imani, Dong Quixote and Bigs the slugalette, and joins Carl and Elle there. For the file: he came out of the Penis Parade with the rest of the dancers when the club came down, signed a mercenary contract, and has been in every fight since without once being the reason a plan failed. Water mage. Short. Reliable. There are crawlers I could not write that sentence about.

beats.headline: An inventory of the safe room
beats.text: Somebody should keep a list, so here is the list. In the safe room: Splash Zone, Rosetta, Samantha, Bigs, and Tipid, who spends most of his time curled up asleep on the training-room floor. Mordecai is a shadow mimic wearing the shape of a Moon Reaper. Mongo and Rend are out in the garage. Carl walks in and picks up a spell for turning himself into ooze. Nobody in that room finds any of it strange, which is the part I would like noted.

beats.headline: He goes to ask Hamed a question
beats.text: Splash Zone, Gluteus Maxx and Doctor Bones went to speak with Hamed. Carl works out that he cannot raise any of the three, and the reason he cannot is that they are not standing on this floor any more. What he went to ask Hamed for was help in finding his wife. That is the whole of what I am prepared to put in the file.
